title: Cedar Lakeside Pottery Studio with Wood-Fired Kiln (Golden Hour Exterior)
prompt: A cedar lakeside pottery studio with a wood-fired kiln shed at golden hour, exterior view from the dock side. Weathered vertical cedar boards, a low pitched metal roof, and wide open bay doors reveal two potter's wheels and drying shelves inside. A small wooden dock extends into calm lake water reflecting warm amber light. Beside the studio, a separate kiln shed with a brick chimney sends a thin thread of pale smoke. Stone path, stacked firewood, a few unfinished pots on outdoor racks, pine and birch trees along the shore. Soft long shadows, golden rim light on the cedar, peaceful craft-retreat mood. Photoreal, landscape 16:9. No people, no text, no cars.
